questions.prompt: A committee of 4 people is to be chosen from a group of 10 candidates.

parts.label: a
parts.prompt: Calculate the number of different committees of 4 people that can be chosen from the 10 candidates.

questions.prompt: A team of 5 people consists of 2 teachers chosen from 6 teachers and 3 students chosen from 8 students.

parts.label: a
parts.prompt: Calculate the number of different teams that can be formed.

questions.prompt: A delegation of 5 students is to be chosen from a class of 12 students. One particular student, Leo, must be included in the delegation.

parts.label: a
parts.prompt: Find the number of different delegations that can be chosen.

questions.prompt: A project panel of 5 members is formed by selecting 2 engineers from 5 available engineers, 2 managers from 7 available managers, and 1 director from 4 available directors.

parts.label: a
parts.prompt: Calculate the number of different panels that can be selected.

questions.prompt: A subcommittee of 5 members is to be chosen from 15 staff members. One particular staff member, Elena, cannot be included on the subcommittee.

parts.label: a
parts.prompt: Find the number of different subcommittees that can be chosen.

questions.prompt: Eleven travel passengers are assigned to three distinct vehicles with designated spaces: Vehicle A receives 4 passengers, Vehicle B receives 4 passengers, and Vehicle C receives the remaining 3 passengers.

parts.label: a
parts.prompt: Calculate the number of different ways to allocate the 11 passengers to the three vehicles.

questions.prompt: A science club has 8 physicists and 6 chemists. A research squad of 5 members is to be formed.

parts.label: a
parts.prompt: Find the number of different squads that contain exactly 3 physicists and 2 chemists.

parts.label: b
parts.prompt: A specific physicist, Dr Aris, must be included in the squad. Find the number of different squads containing Dr Aris, exactly 2 other physicists, and 2 chemists.

questions.prompt: A local council committee of 5 members is selected from 6 councillors, 5 community leaders, and 4 youth representatives.

parts.label: a
parts.prompt: Find the number of different committees that consist of exactly 2 councillors, 2 community leaders, and 1 youth representative.

parts.label: b
parts.prompt: One particular community leader, Marcus, refuses to serve on the committee. Find the number of different committees of 2 councillors, 2 community leaders, and 1 youth representative that can be formed without Marcus.

questions.prompt: A youth leadership team of 5 representatives is chosen from a group of 14 candidates.

parts.label: a
parts.prompt: Find the total number of possible teams if there are no restrictions on who is chosen.

parts.label: b
parts.prompt: Two specific candidates, Hannah and Isaac, must both be included in the team. Find the number of possible teams that include both Hannah and Isaac.

questions.prompt: Ten conference delegates are to be assigned to three distinct discussion workshops: Room Alpha requires 4 delegates, Room Beta requires 3 delegates, and Room Gamma requires 3 delegates.

parts.label: a
parts.prompt: Calculate the number of different ways to assign the 10 delegates to the three rooms.

parts.label: b
parts.prompt: A designated keynote speaker, Professor Vance, must be assigned to Room Alpha. Find the number of different room assignments that satisfy this condition.

questions.prompt: A school debate squad of 5 students is selected from 7 seniors and 5 juniors.

parts.label: a
parts.prompt: Find the number of squads that contain exactly 3 seniors and 2 juniors.

parts.label: b
parts.prompt: A specific senior, Sam, must be included in the squad, while a specific junior, Jordan, cannot be included. Find the number of squads of 3 seniors and 2 juniors that satisfy both conditions.

questions.prompt: A hospital advisory board of 6 members is chosen from a group of 15 medical practitioners.

parts.label: a
parts.prompt: Find the total number of different boards that can be selected with no restrictions.

parts.label: b
parts.prompt: One senior doctor, Dr Chen, must be included on the board. Find the number of boards that include Dr Chen.

parts.label: c
parts.prompt: Dr Chen and another senior doctor, Dr Patel, must both be included on the board. Find the number of boards that include both Dr Chen and Dr Patel.

questions.prompt: An international debate society has 6 senior debaters and 8 novice debaters. A delegation of 5 debaters is to be selected.

parts.label: a
parts.prompt: Find the number of delegations containing exactly 2 senior debaters and 3 novice debaters.

parts.label: b
parts.prompt: A specific senior debater, Arthur, must be included in the delegation. Find the number of delegations of 2 senior debaters and 3 novice debaters that include Arthur.

parts.label: c
parts.prompt: Arthur must be included in the delegation, but a specific novice debater, Beatrice, cannot be included. Find the number of delegations of 2 senior debaters and 3 novice debaters that include Arthur and exclude Beatrice.
